subject: Runtime team: request to repackage reserved seats and adjust comp bands
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Runtime team: request to repackage reserved seats and adjust comp bands

Hi team,

Following our capacity review, I'm proposing we repackage two reserved "runtime" seats currently earmarked for Dedicated capacity engineers into:

- 1 permanent Platform SRE headcount (infra-oriented)
- 1 open IC slot to be repurposed as an accelerated hiring band (higher comp band, narrower scope)

Rationale in attached memo: higher immediate impact on latency SLOs if we prioritize the SRE hire, and we can fill the aggressive IC slot with a senior candidate faster if we raise the comp band by one level. This is effectively moving 2 seats within the runtime/infrastructure portfolio rather than a net increase.

I attached a short note (hc-repackaging-memo.pdf) and a comp-band spreadsheet (comp-band-adjustments.xlsx) with the suggested band changes and the estimated 12-month cost delta. The net monthly burn increase is modest and should be offset by the SRE's immediate throughput improvements (see throughput delta table in the memo).

Asks:
- Kim: do we have latitude on comp-band uplift for the accelerated IC slot? (I marked a recommended band in the spreadsheet).
- Marissa: please confirm the SLA/capacity impact numbers and whether we can avoid any Dedicated contract reorder given this shift.
- Soojin: need your take on hiring runway and whether headcount ops can execute this repackage this quarter.

Goal: decision by end of day Friday so we can update Talent and the Recruiter brief.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Director, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: hc-repackaging-memo.pdf, comp-band-adjustments.xlsx

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-04T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime team: request to repackage reserved seats and adjust comp bands

Thanks Rachel — quick read looks reasonable. A couple of immediate flags:

- We need a clear timeline for when the Dedicated capacity seats become available (contract end / renewal windows). If they're mid-contract we may not be able to reclassify them without a cost.
- Hiring runway: dropping the req into an accelerated band means we should expect a shorter funnel but higher offer acceptance rates. I can have People Ops run the uplift simulation but need the final band you want to target.

Kim: can you confirm band flexibility and whether compensation committee pre-approval is required for a one-level uplift on an open IC role? If yes, I'll prepare a short pre-approval packet for Friday.

Marissa: can you also slice the SLA impact by region? The US capacity is the immediate risk.

— Soojin
Sooin Lee (interim)
Head of Talent Ops (covering hiring cadence)
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-04T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime team: request to repackage reserved seats and adjust comp bands

Adding the SLA/cost numbers after looking at the telemetry:

- US latency tail risk: estimated 6% increase P99 requests if we delay the SRE hire by 3 months. With the SRE in place, we project a 4% reduction in P99 and a 9% improvement in mean throughput for peak windows.
- Cost delta: comp-band uplift adds an estimated $17k/month (on-target, fully loaded) for the senior accelerated IC slot; offset by lower incident MTTR and reduced Dedicated burst costs (roughly $11k/mo saved from reduced burst usage) — net ~+$6k/mo.
- Dedicated contract: the seats flagged are coming up for renewal in 45 days; we have flexibility to shift allocation at renewal without penalty.

Recommendation: green-light the repackage but convert one of the two seats into a 6-month contractor for the first quarter if People Ops cannot deliver a hire in 6 weeks. That keeps throughput improvements on-track while limiting permanent burn.

Cc'ing a note for procurement discussions with Acme AI — they asked about Dedicated capacity commitments and should be able to accept the revised allocation at renewal (Procurement contact: procurement@acmeai.com).

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jennifer Lee <jennifer@talentspot.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-05T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Candidate shortlist and updated availability for accelerated band

FW: Candidate shortlists — forwarding as requested.

Hi Rachel —

Attaching the three candidates we discussed for the accelerated senior runtime IC slot. Short briefs are in the attachments (sent privately to your inbox). Two are ex-infra at hyperscalers; one is a senior engineer currently interviewing with another startup (timeline: expect an offer by 3/12). If you approve the uplift, we'll prioritize outreach and secure early interviews.

Availability for first-round interviews: next week (3/8–3/11) morning PT for all three candidates.

Let me know if you want me to surface comp expectations to the three candidates now (I can tell them the target band if you confirm uplift).

— Jennifer Lee
Recruiting Partner, TalentSpot

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-06T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime team: request to repackage reserved seats and adjust comp bands

Thanks for the clear ask and the numbers. After reviewing comp-band-adjustments.xlsx and the memo: approved with two conditions — please action before Friday's payroll cutoff.

Conditions:
1) Limit permanent uplift to the single accelerated IC slot only; do the contractor conversion for the second seat as Marissa suggested.
2) Talent Ops must include a short sign-off that the role profile is scoped to a senior IC (not a staff-level scope) so we don't implicitly reclassify the seat long-term.

If Soojin can prepare the pre-approval packet (one-pager + justification) by EOD Thursday I will sign off on committee paperwork. Marissa, please confirm the contractor terms (6 months, vendor, expected start). Rachel, once the pre-approval is ready, loop in Jennifer and I'll authorize outreach to candidates.

Kimberly Park
Head of Compensation & Total Rewards
Redwood Inference

[Signed electronically]

Attachments referenced: comp-band-adjustments.xlsx, hc-repackaging-memo.pdf
